notes: IMMUTABLE formal Android review proposal, NOT AGREED; 1000-subject proposed cap pending named owner, 15-minute bounded shared lease. Linked fixtures are models, NOT live-store tests or formal Android ACK.

cases.name: independent_101_change_fixture_first_100
cases.fixture: Separate gen8 history: subjects 555 and 666 followed rev1/2, then 100 single-subject changes at rev3..102 (one unfollow 555 plus 99 new follows), followed by unfollow 666 at rev103. Snapshot checkpoint gen8/rev2; page limit fixed 100.

cases.name: capacity_snapshot_page_1_not_authoritative
cases.fixture: Gen12 exactly 1000 distinct followed UUIDs rev1000; 10 pages of 100. One of two shared snapshot/export images pins <=1000 rows of the <=2MiB logical owner/project/cohort aggregate reservation. Equivalent cursorless requests reuse this image without allocating another. Concurrent writes after rev1000 excluded.

cases.name: capacity_export_page_1_is_not_full_export
cases.fixture: Exactly 1000 distinct followed UUIDs at gen12/rev1000; pages 1..10 enumerate ascending UUID keys, 100/page; page excerpts do not imply missing intermediate pages. Concurrent writes after rev1000 must not alter pinned result.

cases.name: capacity_changes_first_page_pins_fixed_upper
cases.fixture: Gen12 1000 eligible changes rev1..1000; after_revision0. Rev1001..2000 append concurrently AFTER fixed upper1000. Exactly 10 pages of 100. Old checkpoint0 until complete.

cases.name: capacity_lease_at_900_seconds_never_promotes_partial
cases.fixture: Exactly 900 seconds since original FIRST admission, regardless of intervening 429/restart; fixed lease expired, partial stage discarded.

cases.name: capacity_first_page_429_reserves_lease_before_reply
cases.fixture: Admitted generation12/revision1000 owner snapshot; durable fixed 15-minute lease reserved before first 429

cases.name: owner_initial_429_lost_retries_cursorless_without_new_pinned_image
cases.fixture: Phone A lost the first 429 body; repeats same first URL after app restart while phone B separately authenticates. Atomic owner-wide reuse returns same pinned gen12/rev1000/lease, no new rows; page0 cannot get a second 429. A change lease at R0 and another at R500 independently progress.

cases.name: phone_b_concurrent_export_reuses_phone_a_image
cases.fixture: Phone B independently authenticated; snapshot/export purpose cursors differ but same pinned image may be reused while two additional change slots remain.

cases.name: third_device_after_two_distinct_change_slots_uses_snapshot_fallback
cases.fixture: Two independent phone A/B change slots already admitted at R0/R500. Third phone C R100 cannot evict either, gets snapshot_required and may request fresh snapshot or bounded wait.

cases.name: fresh_lease_budget_exhausted_before_first_429
cases.fixture: Distinct owner image must reserve 1MiB logical budget; no existing equivalent image, physical project budget refuses reservation. Fail closed BEFORE page/429.

cases.name: owner_budget_released_at_15min_next_first_request_recovers
cases.fixture: Prior lease expired exactly 15min, cleanup freed reservation, new first request admitted fresh lease at new pinned revision.

cases.name: both_snapshot_slots_full_old_min_rev2_waits_bounded
cases.fixture: Both owner snapshot image slots occupied below rev2. Fresh device min_revision2 receives bounded 503 <=60s retry until oldest fixed <=15min lease expires. No stale image/current-state assertion.

cases.name: stale_lease_expired_new_image_proves_rev2_unfollow
cases.fixture: After <=15min old rev1 image GC frees slot and new image pins rev2; known phone B unfollow now reflected.

cases.name: two_checkpoint_phone_b_changes_pins_newer_upper_1001
cases.fixture: B has distinct checkpoint 500; A lease at R0 remains active. Both independent authorizations checked. Concurrent rev1001 appended after A upper1000 but is inside B upper1001.

cases.name: same_subject_two_phones_10000_edits_retention_cap
cases.fixture: A+B alternated follow/unfollow on SAME UUID 10000 times in rolling 90 days (one distinct subject); 10001st normal edit is unaccepted before any new op/delta row. ≤16MiB logical accepted history; physical PG unmeasured.

cases.name: history_saturated_protected_unfollow_succeeds
cases.fixture: Different saturated history fixture: subject currently followed and protected first unfollow uses one reserved slot; remove-all/withdraw/DSR also remain possible.

cases.name: phone_b_min_rev2_uses_second_free_snapshot_slot_immediately
cases.fixture: Phone A retains rev1 pinned image in slot 1. Phone B independently authorized requests min rev2; free slot 2 pins fresh rev2 immediately; no eviction or stale loop.

cases.name: one_subject_9999_distinct_conflict_ids_consume_budget
cases.fixture: One accepted follow + 9999 separately durably admitted 409 stale-base IDs on same UUID in rolling 90 days = exactly 10000 retained outcomes, one delta, still only one distinct subject. Every admitted conflict consumes outcome budget.

cases.name: one_subject_10001st_new_conflict_id_pre_admission_redacted
cases.fixture: After 10000 retained outcomes, new stale-base ID fails quota BEFORE inserting outcome/delta, even though person_conflict would otherwise apply.

cases.name: history_budget_90day_expiry_recovery_new_explicit_ID
cases.fixture: After 90d GC frees normal outcome budget. Explicit new intent and new ID (NOT replay of unaccepted op), fresh snapshot and current grant.

cases.name: removal_receipts_full_1001st_erasure_uses_current_slot
cases.fixture: Already 1000 indexed 90d removal/withdrawal receipts. This 1001st action still fences gen8, revokes write grants and begins durable erasure using sole current slot; does not evict old receipts.

cases.name: state_only_removal_superseded_lost_202_lookup_unknown
cases.fixture: One later completed privacy action reused the one current recovery slot after first action was terminal; original state-only slot no longer indexable, 1000 existing receipts unaffected.

cases.name: withdrawal_receipts_full_still_revokes_and_erases
cases.fixture: Independent 1000-receipt-saturated cohort; protected withdrawal always fences/revokes/erases via current slot.

cases.name: capacity_page_at_899_seconds_remains_valid
cases.fixture: Exactly 899 seconds since FIRST admission, despite first-429/restart; the same fixed 900-second lease can still return a verified complete final page. Retries never extend admission time.

cases.name: phone_b_cursorless_after_phone_a_lost_first_429_reuses_exact_image
cases.fixture: After A lost first 429 on snapshot page0, separately authorized B repeats cursorless first request; B gets same pinned lease/image and purpose-specific auth, not another 429 or new lease; no cursor grants cross-device authority.

cases.name: 100000_unique_stale_base_ids_one_subject_rejected_beyond_10000_retained
cases.fixture: Two phones alternate 100000 NEW stale-base IDs for SAME UUID in rolling 90d. One successful follow plus 9999 durably admitted conflict IDs fills 10000 normal outcome slots; next 90000 unique attempts, including this one, are pre-admission rejected before subject conflict evaluation. No result/delta/dedup rows for any of 90000; retained outcomes <=10000, raw deltas <=10000 and one distinct subject. Each refused attempt requires explicit new intent/ID only after GC.

cases.name: 1001st_reconsent_id_pre_admission_denied_privacy_actions_still_allowed
cases.fixture: 1000 accepted re-consent IDs in last 90d following 1000 separately allowed protected withdrawals; 1001st NEW ID gets no grant/new binding/generation advance. Old accepted identical same-generation replay uses original binding, never allocates new slot.

cases.name: state_only_withdrawal_superseded_lost_202_status_unknown
cases.fixture: After receipt budget full, state_only withdrawal 202 was lost; this action reached terminal then a later separately confirmed privacy action reused the one current slot. The old state-only ID is not retained for 90 days (indexed 1000 prior IDs still are).
